Hero.title: Power Paint
Hero.description: An infinite whiteboard for collaboration. Draw, plan, and bring ideas to life with your team in real time.

Features.infinite_canvas_description: Work on a canvas that never ends.
Features.multiplayer_description: Collaborate while seeing every cursor movement of your colleagues.
Features.custom_tools_description: Create and use your own drawing tools.
Features.open_source_description: Use and contribute to open source code.
Features.cloud_storage_description: Store your work in the cloud and access it from anywhere.

feature_cards.return_to_focus_desc: Jump back to the right spot on the canvas when you get lost in zoom or movement.
feature_cards.smart_eraser_desc: Remove brush strokes in a single motion, or hold Alt to quickly clear selection without breaking your flow.
feature_cards.role_based_access_desc: Control who can view, edit, or manage the board without adding complexity.
feature_cards.collaborative_editing_desc: Let multiple people work at once without stepping on each other’s ideas.
feature_cards.more_than_board: More than a board for any task
feature_cards.more_than_board_desc: Use advanced capabilities—from real-time collaboration and flexible editing to access control and other tools designed for any workflow.
